how_settled.compared: record_facts of A-1..A-5 (first) against R2-1..R2-5 (second), field by field, ignoring existing_use_text, prior_approval_limits, operator_name and record_sources: 40 cases x 27 fields = 1,080.
how_settled.count_note: 90 fields are not byte-identical. 5 are not differences of content and are listed per case under "form_only": D03 story (order); D02, D05, D07 existing_use_stated (one value against a one-item list); D19 licences_already_held (null against an empty list, which the engine reads alike). 85 differ in content and are settled.
how_settled.form: existing_use_stated is written as a list in every case (convention 2); a single value in the first reading is wrapped, nothing added. All other agreed fields are the first reading unchanged. record_facts carries exactly the 30 fact keys; figures set aside under convention 3 are in each case's "note" and in the settled item, not inside record_facts.
rules_applied: merges_storefronts: false where the record rules out alterations, physical work, expansion or enlargement, or says no storefront is modified or no merger arises; null where it only shows one storefront.

changes_existing_business: null where no existing business or use carries on (new use in a vacant space); "none" where the business or use carries on and the record says it is not enlarged or intensified; a licence upgrade alone is not recorded as "intensify" unless the record uses the word (N05 convention; D20 uses it, D02 does not).
existing_use_stated: the premises after the project; each part's last use, plus "vacant" where the record says so.

new_construction: true where the record says a structure or addition is built (D01, as D05 and N06); false where it says the envelope is untouched or describes the whole scope as work inside an existing space; null otherwise.
alcohol_transaction: null unless the record says "new", "transfer" or already held.
floor_area_before_sqft: the existing space's stated area where the record gives it; never a figure obtained by subtraction.
